nominal_interference.reason: Unresolved: every Neutrik/REAN drawing puts the rows at 4.00/10.35/16.70 mm from the housing front; the Eagle footprint sits 0.35 mm further back and no source explains its datum (models-review-14).
Eagle places the side terminal at 4.6/10.862 vs the drawing 4.7/10.7 mm, within +-0.2 mm (models-review-14).
Eagle grid positions (pin 1 at 7.62 vs 7.5, pin 2 at 12.68 vs 12.5 mm) within the drawing tolerance of +-0.2 mm (models-review-14).

The recovered Kobiconn154-2442-E drawing recommends2.30mm mounting holes, while Eagle drills2.2mm. The retained illustrative2.4x0.30mm free-state board-lock fork shape and original axes produce the same nominal0.2392mm wall excess. The exact fitted part and elastic deformation remain unqualified (models-review-18).

Manufacturer CAD draws the snap-in retention kinks in their free, uncompressed state; the straight shoulders and solder tips fit, and the Eagle drill (1.19 mm) is smaller than the recommended 1.3 mm (control-quality/tl1100-pin-section-audit.json).
